title: Memory Game in Python!

steps.title: Step 1: Setup
steps.explanation: We import random and create a list of 8 cards, shuffled for randomness.

steps.title: Step 2: Game Loop
code_lines: print(" ".join(str(cards[i]) if revealed[i] else "X" for i in range(8)))
steps.explanation: We track revealed cards and print the board with Xs for hidden cards.

steps.title: Step 3: Player Interaction
steps.explanation: The player picks a card, and it gets revealed if valid.

steps.title: Step 4: Win Condition
steps.explanation: Once all cards are revealed, the player wins and the game ends.

steps.title: Step 5: Try It Yourself!
steps.explanation: Try it yourself and see if you can beat the game!

intro_hook: Let's build a memory game in 30 seconds!
